body.x: iSet(www.isetwatch.com) introduced "iSetwatch" at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.This waterproof device can tracks the match result of tennis players real time. The performance can be monitored remotely by the coach, parents, and friends through mobile devices. It also has useful functions like watch, alarm, stopwatch, and downtimer.
